title: SaaS Security
scope: Multi-tenant B2B/SaaS product codebases (TypeScript/Node, PostgreSQL, cloud)
abstract: Secure-by-default architecture and implementation guardrails for agents shipping scalable SaaS: Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability, Authentication, and Non-Repudiation, plus first-class authorization. Covers STRIDE threat modeling, IDOR/BOLA prevention, PostgreSQL RLS tenant isolation, Argon2id and session/JWT hygiene, SSO readiness, secrets and PII logging, API abuse controls, LLM prompt-injection boundaries, SCA, environment isolation, audit logs, backups, incident runbooks, and technical mapping to OWASP ASVS 5.0 and SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria. Each rule compares incorrect and correct TypeScript/SQL patterns. Defensive only; not legal advice.
